title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The Session 3 app draws hydrophobic beads in red and polar beads in blue; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette or marker shape (for example circles and squares) that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] H and P beads distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: a stiffer backbone (bending forces)
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. The shipped chain is perfectly flexible, so its hot Rg is only 2.09 sigma.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint (hot Rg at least 2.3) is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add error bars and block averaging to the mini-project
body:
## Problem
The mini-project reports a folding temperature from only four runs per temperature.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 3: the standard error of the mean Rg at T = 0.40 is about 0.045 with four runs.

## Expected outcome
A helper that returns the mean Rg and its standard error, with a plot that shows the error bars.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Standard error below 0.03 sigma at T = 0.40
- [ ] Short note on how many runs or blocks you used

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a 3D 20-bead chain that folds on cooling
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a 3D chain with a stiff backbone folding as it is cooled; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Final Rg below 1.6 sigma in 10 of 10 seeds
- [ ] Clear statement in the write-up that it is a toy model

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Exhaustive lattice enumeration of the HP sequence
body:
## Problem
There is no exact reference for the 12-bead sequence.

## Context
On a square lattice the 12-bead chain has a finite number of self-avoiding walks, so the best number of H-H contacts can be found exactly.

## Expected outcome
A script that enumerates all walks, counts H-H contacts of non-consecutive beads, and prints the maximum.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The number of walks is 120292 when the first step is not fixed
- [ ] Maximum contacts printed and explained

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
